description:
About the Role

We’re looking for a detail-obsessed, highly organized Virtual Assistant to be the operational backbone of Arise Financial Coaching. This is a behind-the-scenes, keep-everything-moving kind of role — the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks so our lead coach can stay focused on delivering life-changing results to clients.



You will be working inside a fast-growing financial coaching business that handles sensitive client data every single day. ntum.

Monitoring the client support inbox and triaging incoming tickets,
s, and requests

Systems & Admin

Keeping ClickUp task templates active and on track across all client workflows

Supporting the team with scheduling, documentation, and internal coordination

Maintaining SOPs and keeping the operations manual up to date

Team & Coach Support

Supporting coaches with pre-session prep logistics — confirming client readiness, flagging outstanding documents

Tracking weekly hours submissions from coaching tea
mbers

Flagging blockers, inconsistencies, or process gaps proactively before they become problems



Software & Platforms We Use

Airtable — client database, automation workflows, and operational hub

ActiveCampaign —
 marketing and onboarding sequences

ThriveCart / ThriveCart Learn — payment processing and course delivery

Google Workspace —
, Drive, Docs, Sheets

This Position IS for You If…

You have expert-level Airtable experience — you understand bases, views, automations, interfaces, and linked records, and you can troubleshoot without hand-holding

You have a genuine interest in or love for personal finance — you find the world of money, debt payoff, and financial systems genuinely exciting

You are proactive and self-directed — you notice what needs to be done and do it without waiting to be asked

You are highly organized and can manage multiple priorities, client workflows, and moving pieces at once

You are reliable, responsive, and take your commitments seriously

You thrive in dynamic environments where no two days look exactly the same

You need constant direction or check-ins to know what to do next

Compensation

title: Marketing Operations Coordinator (US Marketing Agency, Night Shift, Long-Term)
description:
We are LN & Co., a multicultural digital marketing agency based in Washington, DC. We have been in business since 2019 and we work with nonprofits, faith-based organizations, social justice clients, and purpose-driven consumer brands across the United States.



We are hiring a Marketing Operations Coordinator to work directly with our Founder and CEO as a long-term extension of her daily operations. This is a full-time, long-term position. We are not looking for project work or short-term help.

Please Read Carefully Before Applying



This role runs on US Eastern Time, Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM EST. In Philippine Time, this is 9:00 PM to 5:00 AM the next day. This is a permanent night shift role. Please only apply if you have done night shift work before for a US client and you can sustain this schedule long-term. You will get a one-hour break during the shift.



What You Will Do

s and messages on behalf of the CEO

 - Support our
 marketing and keep our website content updated

 - Build client reports, presentations, and decks

You Must Have

 - A college degree

 - Previous work experience inside a marketing, advertising, PR, or communications agency. In-house or freelance experience alone will not qualify for this role.

 - Expert-level Notion skills. You should be able to build databases, relations, filtered views, formulas, and templates from scratch without help. We will test this during the hiring process with a paid skills assessment.

 - Excellent written and spoken English

 - Proven ability to work US night shift hours consistently

Nice to Have but Not Required

 - Experience supporting faith-based clients, churches, or nonprofits

 - Experience with social justice or advocacy organizations

 - Mailchimp, Kit, or ConvertKit experience

 - Sprout Social, Hootsuite, or Buffer experience

 - Canva and Google Workspace fluency

 - Basic WordPress experience



Salary

$1,200 to $2,000 USD per month, depending on experience and performance during the hiring process. Paid monthly in USD through Wise or Deel. We do not pay through PayPal.



Hours

Full-time, 40 hours per week. Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM Eastern Time (9:00 PM to 5:00 AM Philippine Time). One-hour break included.



What We Offer

 - Long-term, stable employment with a growing US agency

 - Direct mentorship from the Founder and CEO

 - Real ownership of meaningful work, not task-rabbit assignments

 - Annual rate increases based on performance

 - Paid time off after the first 90 days

 - A team that respects your time and your craft

Please do not send a generic application. Applications that look copy-pasted will be ignored.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a paid Notion build exercise (60 to 90 minutes, paid at $75 USD) and a short video interview.

description:
Assistant Property Manager

Aoede LLC | 100% Remote | Full-Time



About the Role



The Assistant Property Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operations, support, and customer service of a growing, diversified real estate portfolio across Texas and California. This includes a 70-unit commercial building in Houston, TX, single-family rental properties in California, and short-term rental (Airbnb) properties in Austin, TX. This is a 100% remote, full-time, long-term position.



We do annual team bonding trips in the Philippines — if you're talented, hardworking, and ambitious, we'd love to meet you in person and talk about where your career is headed.



What You'll Do



- Direct and oversee daily operations across a mixed portfolio of commercial, single-family, and short-term rental properties

- Provide excellent customer service to all tenants, guests, and prospects

- Prepare and send communication notices to tenants

- Draft lease agreements and manage property documentation

- Coordinate maintenance requests and vendor communication across multiple property types

- Enter accounts receivable and accounts payable into QuickBooks

- Perform monthly bank reconciliations

- Ensure accuracy and timely preparation of all required reports

- Schedule tea
etings, coordinate via Zoom, and delegate tasks to tea
mbers

- Manage Airbnb listings, guest communications, and short-term rental operations



What We're Looking For



- 2+ years of property management experience

- Experience supporting US-based properties preferred

- Experience with any combination of commercial, residential, or short-term rental management is a plus

- Proficiency in QuickBooks

- Expert-level use of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)

- Familiarity with property management software (AppFolio a plus)

- Comfortable using Asana, Slack, and Zoom for daily communication

- Strong written and spoken English

- Detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple priorities across different property types

- Bachelor's degree preferred

- Humble, coachable, and eager to learn US property management regulations (Section 8, rent control, tenant/landlord laws in California and Texas)



What We Offer



- 100% remote position — work from home

- Long-term role with real growth potential

- On-the-spot bonuses for high performers

- Raises considered at performance evaluations for those who master the training material and execute at a high level

- Extensive runbooks and tutorials to support your development

- Annual team bonding trips in the Philippines

- A team culture that values hard work, initiative, and continuous learning



---



Our Hiring Process



1. Apply — Submit your application with the details listed below

2. Initial Review — We review your experience and qualifications

3. Assessment — Qualified candidates receive a TestGorilla skills assessment (~1 hour, webcam required)

4. Interview — Candidates who score at or above the 50th percentile are invited to a Zoom interview

5. Offer & Onboarding — Successful candidates begin with a 3-month probation period with full training and support



---



Frequently Asked Questions



What types of properties will I manage?

You'll support a diversified portfolio that includes a 70-unit commercial building in Houston, single-family rental homes in California, and short-term rental (Airbnb) properties in Austin. This role gives you broad exposure across multiple property types.



What are the working hours?

You will be expected to work US Central Time business hours. This is a full-time position (40 hours/week).



How and when do I get paid?

Pay is on the 1st and 15th of each month via Wise (
).



Is this freelance or full-time?

This is a full-time, dedicated position. Freelancing or side work is not allowed. We need your full commitment.



Do you provide equipment?

You must have your own laptop, headset, and reliable high-speed internet connection.



Is there a probation period?

Yes, there is a 3-month probation period. After that, performance evaluations are conducted every 6 months.



How do raises and bonuses work?

We offer on-the-spot bonuses for exceptional work. Raises are considered at your 6-month performance evaluations based on how well you learn the training material and execute your responsibilities.



What training and support do you provide?

We have extensive runbooks, tutorials, and experienced tea
mbers to help you get up to speed. We invest in people who are willing to learn.



What software will I need to learn?

AppFolio (property management), QuickBooks (accounting), Asana (task management), Slack (communication), and Zoom (meetings). If you don't know all of these yet, that's okay — what matters is your willingness to learn quickly.



---



To Apply



Please include:

1. A brief summary of your property management experience

2. Which Western countries you've supported (if any)

3. What types of properties you've managed (commercial, residential, short-term rental)

4. What PM and accounting software you've used

5. Your availability to start



About Aoede LLC

About the Role



The Senior Assistant Property Manager is a leadership role responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operations of a growing, diversified real estate portfolio across Texas and California. This includes a 70-unit commercial building in Houston, TX, single-family rental properties in California, and short-term rental (Airbnb) properties in Austin, TX.

mber needs it — or take over a task entirely when the situation calls for it. Our leadership philosophy is trust but verify: you empower your team to execute, then you follow up and confirm the work was done correctly.



This is a 100% remote, full-time, long-term position.

mbers are stuck or struggling

etings, delegate tasks, and hold tea

- Prepare and send communication notices to tenants

- Coordinate via Zoom, Slack, and Asana daily

- Proven experience managing commercial, residential, or short-term rental properties in the US

mbers — you must have real examples of how you've delegated work, verified completion, coached tea
mbers through challenges, and stepped in to take over when needed

- Financially literate — comfortable with budgets, vendor negotiations, and lease pricing decisions

- Dependable, proactive, and able to make sound decisions without constant oversight

- 100% remote position — work from home

- Long-term role with real growth potential into senior management

- On-the-spot bonuses for high performers

- Raises considered at performance evaluations for those who master the training material and execute at a high level

- Extensive runbooks and tutorials to support your development

- Annual team bonding trips in the Philippines

- A team culture that values hard work, initiative, and continuous learning



---



Our Hiring Process



1. Apply — Submit your application with the details listed below

2. Initial Review — We review your experience and qualifications

3. Assessment — Qualified candidates receive a TestGorilla skills assessment (~1 hour, webcam required)

4. Interview — Candidates who score at or above the 50th percentile are invited to a Zoom interview

5. Reference Check — We contact your 3 US-based references to verify your property management experience

6. Offer & Onboarding — Successful candidates begin with a 3-month probation period with full training and support



---



Frequently Asked Questions



What types of properties will I manage?

).

You must have your own laptop, headset, and reliable high-speed internet connection.

Yes, there is a 3-month probation period. After that, performance evaluations are conducted every 6 months.

We offer on-the-spot bonuses for exceptional work. Raises are considered at your 6-month performance evaluations based on how well you learn the training material, lead your team, and execute your responsibilities.

mbers to help you get up to speed on our specific processes. While we expect you to bring US property management knowledge, we'll train you on our systems and workflows.

title: Video Editor (Long-Form + Short-Form) — Truck & Automotive Content
description:
Type: Project-based / part-time (with a clear path to full-time as volume grows)

Schedule: You work on your time as long as deadlines are hit.



About Us

We're Truck Bed Supplies — a US-based truck accessories brand building out a growing content engine across YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok. Think truck builds, overlanding, gear reviews, and install content (a Nico's Garage–style vibe, but for the truck-bed and overlanding world).



I shoot the footage. You own the edit — you'll cut my raw long-form videos into finished pieces, then repurpose each one into a batch of short-form clips built to stop the scroll and pull people back to the channel and store.



What You'll Do



Long-form editing:

- Turn raw footage into polished long-form YouTube videos (reviews, builds, installs, vlogs — typically 8–15 min)

- Build a story: structure the cut, tighten pacing, kill dead air, keep retention high

- Sound design (music beds, SFX, audio leveling) and basic color correction

- On-brand styling: intro/outro, lower-thirds, titles

- B-roll, light motion graphics, and text overlays where they earn their place



Short-form repurposing (core):

- Cut 6–10 vertical clips (YouTube Shorts, Reels, TikTok — 9:16) from each long-form video

- Find the hooks — the clip-worthy 
nts — not just chop the video into pieces

- Add clean, readable, properly timed captions/subtitles

- Punch up the first 1–3 seconds for retention; keep each clip on-brand



Delivery:

- Organized, ready-to-post files with consistent naming

- Hit agreed deadlines and communicate proactively if something's off

- Post On All Channels



What I'm Looking For

- 2+ years editing both long-form and short-form content, with a portfolio to prove it

- Strong storytelling and pacing instincts on long-form — you understand structure, not just cuts

- Sharp eye for hooks and retention on short-form

- Clean caption/subtitle work — timing and readability matter

- Solid sound design and color correction fundamentals

- Strong written English and quick, clear communication

- Reliable with deadlines, comfortable working async (10–13 hr time difference from US Eastern)

- Bonus: interest in cars/trucks/outdoor/overlanding content — helps you spot the 
nts that matter



Nice to Have

- Motion graphics / animated text

- Thumbnail design

- Experience editing for an automotive, outdoor, or e-commerce creator brand

- Knowledge of what performs on each platform (Shorts vs Reels vs TikTok)



Compensation

This is project-based to start. I'd rather pay fairly for great work than chase the cheapest rate.

- Long-form edit: $60–$130 USD per video, based on length and complexity (raw footage ? finished YouTube video)

- Short-form clip: $25–$35 USD each (captioned, hooked, on-brand)

- Batch package (preferred): I film in "hero sessions." We'll set a flat rate per batch — e.g., 1 long-form + 6–8 shorts — once we know your speed and quality. Expect roughly $250–$400 per batch.

- Revisions: 1–2 rounds included per deliverable; reasonable scope

- Path to full-time: As output grows, I want to convert the right person to a steady monthly retainer / full-time role (in the range of $1,000–$1,500/mo for consistent, high-quality output). 



How to Apply



Start your message with the word "OVERLAND." Applications without it get skipped.



Please include:

- A short intro — who you are and why this content interests you

- 2–3 portfolio links — include at least one long-form edit and one vertical short you personally edited

- The tools you edit in

- Roughly how many videos/batches you can turn around per week

title: AI Content Operator - @Real_bruno_souza
description:
Company: Black Swan Media



Reports to: Copy-Chief

Type: Full-time

Hours: Monday–Friday, 4:00 AM – 12:00 PM US Eastern



Compensation: Competitive, based on experience



About us

We run Digital Wealth Lab — a mentorship teaching corporate professionals how to build AI marketing businesses serving local businesses. The brand 
 is built on one promise: show people the exact system, no hype, no guru theater. We've built a proprietary Claude-based content engine that produces high-performing Instagram content at scale. You'd join a small, senior team where your work ships every day and the numbers are visible.

The role



You'll operate our AI content system to produce Instagram carousels (and reels down the line) for Bruno's personal brand. Your job is to produce content that stops the scroll, drives DMs, and turns attention into qualified leads.

The AI does the heavy lifting on creation. You operate it, hold the quality bar, brief the designers and editors, and make every output land before it ships. Over time you help sharpen the system itself.



What you'll do



Run daily sessions in our AI project to produce carousels and reels

QA every output against the brand voice, the format specs, and our content guidelines

Edit and rewrite AI outputs at the sentence level — most posts need human polish before they ship

Hand off finished copy to designers and video editors with clear briefs

Track what's working, what's failing, what's getting flagged

Feed learnings back into the AI project so it gets sharper every week

Own the lead and growth numbers from organic IG content



Core skills required



IG creator economy experience. You've worked with creators or coaches in the business-opportunity, finance, or self-improvement space. Theme page experience is a bonus.

Copywriting judgment. Non-negotiable. You won't write Bruno's content from scratch — the AI does that. But you need a copywriter's brain: you read a hook and instantly know whether it lands, you understand why one slide converts and another dies, and you can tell the AI exactly what's wrong and how to fix it. If you can't critique copy at a high level, you can't run this system.



Marketing. You think in funnels, hooks, offers, and conversion — not just engagement. 

You can read a piece of content and tell whether it's built to grow followers, generate leads, or sell, and you know when to use which.



Production-level AI prompting. Not "I've used ChatGPT." You ship real work with Claude or GPT, iterate when an output is weak, and push back instead of accepting the first draft.



Analytics and feedback-loop literacy. You make data-driven content decisions. You log what worked, what failed, what got flagged, and feed it back into the system.



Bonus (not required, strong plus)



Theme page / shoutout space

Coaching and info-product space (biz op, high-ticket, masterminds)

Personal brand operations for a creator with 100k+ followers

Funnels that turn IG attention into DMs, booked calls, or sales

Ghostwriting or voice-matching — working in a brand voice that isn't yours



Do not apply if



Your instinct is to inject your own voice over the brand's. The voice belongs to Bruno. Your job is to ship work indistinguishable from him writing it himself.

You can't tell a good hook from a bad one without overthinking it. Taste is the job.

You want a writing role. This is an operator role — you run a system, you don't write from scratch.

You can't commit to the 4 AM – 12 PM US Eastern schedule, Monday–Friday.





Application Process

Step 1: Loom Video / Video Introduction

As the next step, please share a 5-minute Loom video or a recording from any video app introducing yourself and walking us through why you're a strong fit for this role.

In your video, please cover:



Who you are and your relevant experience

Why this role interests you

Why you believe you're the right fit

How you currently use AI in your work

Any examples of similar work you've done, especially using AI to create, operate, improve, or scale content workflows

How your experience connects to the responsibilities described in the job description



Please keep the video focused, clear, and relevant to the role.



Step 2: Task

Part 1 — Go through Bruno's profile. Conduct research on Instagram. Come up with 5 post ideas (hooks + post outline) that would fit Bruno's content strategy.

You DO NOT need to write the full carousel/reel for this part.



Example of an idea:

Hook:

At 20 I was working a 9-5 making $52k. I failed 6 businesses over the next 4 years. Everyone around me thought I was done. Then one boring AI tool changed everything.

Post outline:

Use Bruno's story and the exact system he followed to explain how the AI marketing business works. Use specific numbers, named tools, and the math that closes (tool cost vs. what the client pays).

Part 2 — Using Claude, generate the full carousel for 2 of the ideas you created in Part 1.

Please attach the transcript of your chat with Claude so we can review your skill, prompting approach, and familiarity with using AI for content writing. You have 24–48 hours to share your submission once you receive the document.

Submission

Please submit the following:



Your 5-minute Loom/video link

Your 5 hooks and carousel ideas

The 2 full carousels generated with Claude

The transcript of your Claude chat



Thank you again for applying. We're looking forward to reviewing your submission and learning more about how you work.

title: Tik Tok Shop Video editor/VA
description:
Job Title: Virtual Assistant / Video Editor for TikTok Shop (Beginner Friendly)



About the Role



I am looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to help me with basic video editing for my TikTok Shop account. The tasks are super simple, and beginners are more than welcome to apply! I will provide the raw clips, and your job will be to make quick, basic edits to get them ready for posting.



Responsibilities



The two most important parts of this job are the following, and they should be your main focus with every video:



1. Cut out all dead space between clips. The videos need to be fast-paced and tight. Any pauses, gaps, or slow 
nts between clips must be removed so the viewer stays engaged from start to finish. Retention is everything on TikTok, and a well-paced edit is the number one priority.



2. Add plenty of overlays and photos throughout the video. You will be finding and inserting relevant images and overlays consistently throughout each video to keep the viewer visually stimulated and watching. The more engaging the visuals, the better.



In addition to the above, you will also add a few brief onscreen text captions throughout the video to summarize key points. These do not need to be excessive — just enough to reinforce what is being said and help viewers who are watching without sound.



Requirements



The main technical requirement for this job is that you must have a smartphone capable of downloading and running TikTok Studio. All editing will be done using this specific app, which is completely free and very easy to use.



No advanced editing experience is required, and beginners are absolutely fine! You just need to be willing to learn, follow simple instructions, and have a reliable internet connection to receive raw clips and upload the finished videos.



Attention to detail is a must. To ensure you are reading this entire job post, at the subject of your application, put your favorite season of the year. If you do not have this, we will not consider you for this job.



Pay & Schedule



The pay rate for this position is $4.00 USD per hour, paid weekly. You will be required to keep a timesheet logging your hours worked each day, which will be used to calculate your weekly payment.



In terms of workload, I typically produce between 4 and 9 videos per day. The editing tasks are intentionally simple, so you should be able to comfortably complete around 4 videos per hour. On a typical day, this means the work will take you roughly 1 to 2.5 hours to complete.



Workflow



Raw video clips will be shared with you through a shared Google Drive folder. You will download the clips, edit them using TikTok Studio on your phone, and then re-upload the finished videos back to the same Google Drive folder. No complicated file-sharing tools — just a simple, straightforward process.



All edited videos must be returned within 24 hours of receiving the raw clips. For example, if I send you the clips on Monday, I need them back by Tuesday. This turnaround time is essential so I can maintain a consistent daily posting schedule.



Growth Opportunity



This is not just a one-off project — I am looking for someone to grow with long-term. As my TikTok Shop continues to scale, there will be opportunities for increased hours, additional responsibilities, and higher pay for the right person. If you are reliable, consistent, and take pride in your work, there is a real future here.

title: SDR/BDR/Cold Calling Trainer | Training Specialist | Onboarding Specialist
description:
About Us

StoryGen is a fast-growing B2B lead generation agency that builds and manages outbound sales teams for our clients. Our specialty is cold calling, supported by tight operations, automations, and AI-driven tools.

Behind every high-performing BDR team is strong onboarding, structured training, and consistent coaching. That’s where you come in.



About the Role

As an Operations Associate for BDR Training and Enablement, you will be responsible for onboarding new Business Development Representatives (BDRs), training them on cold calling frameworks, and ensuring they are fully prepared to book and hold qualified meetings for our clients.



This role is performance-focused. Your success will be measured by how quickly new BDRs ramp, how consistently they execute scripts and processes, and how effectively they book and hold meetings.



You will work closely with BDRs, Account Managers, and leadership to ensure consistent performance standards across the team.



This role is ideal for someone confident in coaching others, comfortable leading training sessions, and passionate about developing people even if your experience comes from school, internships, or volunteer work.



What You’ll Do



1. BDR Onboarding & Ramp-Up

- Lead onboarding sessions for new BDRs

- Train new hires on cold calling frameworks, scripts, and call structure

- Walk BDRs/Cold Callers through tools, workflows, and dialing processes

- Ensure new BDRs understand KPIs, performance expectations, and quality standards

- Monitor early-stage performance and provide structured feedback

- Ensure BDRs are fully ramped and confident before independent execution



2. Call Coaching & Performance Development

- Listen to call recordings and provide constructive feedback

- Coach BDRs/Cold Callers on objection handling, tonality, confidence, and structure

- Reinforce script adherence while improving personalization and delivery

- Identify skill gaps and develop improvement plans

- Work with underperforming BDRs to improve booking and hold rates

- Ensure consistency in call quality across the team



3. Training Materials & Documentation Development

- Develop and update training materials for BDR/Cold Caller onboarding

- Create structured training guides, call frameworks, and objection-handling resources

- Maintain updated script libraries and best-practice documents

- Improve onboarding documentation as processes evolve

- Build repeatable training systems that shorten ramp time



4. Continuous Improvement & Team Enablement

- Collaborate with leadership on improving training systems

- Support implementation of AI call review tools and coaching workflows

- Identify recurring performance trends and recommend improvements

- Help build a scalable BDR/Cold Caller training framework as the team grows



What We’re Looking For

We are open to fresh graduates and candidates without formal work experience, as long as you can demonstrate strong coaching, training, or leadership experience (e.g., in university, student organizations, internships, or volunteer work).



- Strong interpersonal and communication skills

- Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, or train others

- Leadership experience (formal or informal)

- Team-oriented mindset and ability to collaborate closely with others

- Confident communicator and natural coach

- Comfortable giving direct but constructive feedback

- Organized and structured in training delivery

- Performance-oriented mindset

- Strong documentation and material-building ability

- Positive, motivating presence with high accountability standards



Work Schedule

- Full-time role

- Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM – 6:00 PM Eastern Time

- Must be available during U.S. Eastern Time business hours



Compensation & Benefits

- USD 1000 base pay + performance-based incentives

- 100% remote

- Direct impact on team performance and revenue growth

- Opportunity to shape and build the company’s BDR training framework

- Growth path into Enablement Lead or Performance Manager roles

- Collaborative, fast-paced team environment



How to Apply

To ensure a fair and streamlined hiring process, all applicants are asked to complete the assessment.

Please be prepared to submit the following in the same link:



- Your updated resume

- Internet speed test results

- A short Loom audio introduction recording (Instructions and guide questions are included in the assessment. Please configure Loom before starting to ensure you're ready to record once you begin the assessment)

title: AI Video Editor for DTC E-commerce Brands (US Market) — Full Time
description:
Job Title: Experienced AI Video Editor for DTC E-commerce Brands (US Market) — Full Time



Salary: $5.50/hour starting ($950/month full time)



Job Type: Full Time, 40 hours/week

Hours: Flexible — work whenever suits you, no US time zone overlap required

Schedule: Monday to Saturday (Sunday optional). Focus is on weekly output, not on tracked hours.



About us

We're a US-focused DTC e-commerce company running multiple health & wellness brands. We advertise on Meta Ads and Google Ads. We're scaling our paid ad creative production aggressively and need a second AI video editor to join our team alongside our existing editor. Both report directly to the founder.



The role in one sentence

You receive a script + reference video + brand assets in a Google Drive folder. You produce a finished, ad-ready video plus hook variants. No back-and-forth, no clarifying questions on every brief. You figure it out and ship.



Video formats you'll work on

We produce a wide mix of video lengths — you must be comfortable with all of them:

- Short-form ads (15–60 seconds) for Meta feed and reels

- Mid-form ads (2–3 minutes) for Meta and YouTube

- Long-form VSLs (5–8 minutes) for YouTube ads and advertorial pages

- Hook variants (5–10 different opening seconds for the same body)



Strong preference for candidates with VSL experience. If you've edited Video Sales Letters before — for any DTC brand, supplement company, info product, or direct response advertiser — make sure to highlight it.



What you'll do

- Produce 10–15 video assets per week (mix of formats above)

- Generate AI footage using the tools we provide: Veo, Kling, Runway, Higgsfield, and Nano Banana Pro

- Master these AI tools — we expect you to use them daily and produce custom shots for every video

- Match cuts, pacing and timing to the script and voiceover with strong attention to the first 3 seconds (hook)

- Add captions, sound design, music, and basic motion graphics

- Organize all final files cleanly in our Google Drive structure



You're a fit if

- You've edited paid ads (Meta / Google / YouTube) for DTC brands before — not weddings, not corporate explainers, not YouTube essay channels

- You have edited VSLs (5+ minutes) at least once — bonus if you've done many

- You can take a written script and produce a finished video without asking what every line should look like

- You actively use AI video tools (Veo / Kling / Runway / Higgsfield) and can show recent work where you used them

- You can sustain 10–15 video assets per week consistently, not in occasional bursts

- Your written English is clear



You're not a fit if

- You need detailed shot lists or storyboards to start working

- You've never used an AI video generator

- You've only done short-form content and never edited anything longer than 60 seconds

- You see this as a side gig — we need consistent weekly output



Compensation & Growth

- Starting rate: $5.50/hour ($950/month full time)

- 90-day review: rate increases to $6.00–6.50/hour based on output volume and ad performance

- 6-month potential: $7.00+/hour for top performers who consistently produce winners

- 60-day trial period before any long-term commitment



How to apply

Reply with ALL of the following. Applications missing any item will be auto-rejected:



1. Your portfolio: at least 5 ad video samples covering different lengths (short-form + mid-form + VSL ideally). For each one, tell me:

   - The brand name (or industry if under NDA)

   - The video length

   - Which platform it ran on (Meta / YouTube / Google)

   - Whether you used AI tools, and which ones



2. AI tools sample: one specific video where you used an AI generator (Veo / Kling / Runway / Higgsfield / etc). Tell me which tool, what you generated, and link to the final output.



3. Visual thinking test: a 2–3 sentence answer to this scenario — "You receive a 30-second script for a sleep product. The first line of the script is: 'If you snore at night, your partner is suffering more than you think.' What's the first visual you'd put on screen, and why did you choose that visual specifically?"



4. Capacity: how many videos do you currently produce per week, for which brands, and how many hours per week are you currently committed to other clients?



To confirm you've read the full job post, start your application with the word "BANANA".

title: Miro Flowchart / Automation Workflow Documentation Assistant
description:
Job Title: Miro Flowchart / Automation Workflow Documentation Assistant



Job Type: Part-time / Project-Based

Work Location: Remote



Job Description:



I am looking for someone experienced with Miro flowcharts, workflow diagrams, process mapping, and automation documentation.



I have an existing Miro flowchart for a field service intake automation project, but the chart is now outdated. The project has changed and improved during planning, and I need someone to help bring the Miro flowchart current.



The project involves:



* CallTrackingMetrics / CTM call tracking

* n8n automation workflows

* FieldPulse customer/job workflow planning

* Voice AI intake agent planning

* Complete and incomplete service request handling

* Pending human review workflow

* SMS/email alerts

* Future CTM + Voice AI + FieldPulse integration

* Legacy RingCentral number handling

* Source tracking and intake classification



You do not need to build the automation. This role is for updating and organizing the Miro flowchart so the workflow is clear, logical, and easy for developers to understand.



Main Responsibilities:



* Review my current Miro flowchart

* Review written notes, screenshots, and workflow instructions I provide

* Update the flowchart to match the current automation plan

* Organize the chart into clear sections/modules

* Clean up outdated steps, duplicate logic, and confusing branches

* Add new sections for:



  * CTM tracking-number intake

  * n8n intake processing

  * FieldPulse-ready output

  * incomplete intake / pending human review

  * Voice AI call flow

  * future Voice AI to n8n handoff

  * alert routing

  * legacy RingCentral number handling

* Use clear labels, colors, and grouping

* Create a flowchart that can be used as a planning and developer handoff document



Important:



This is not a coding role. I am hiring separate developers for the actual n8n and Voice AI builds.



This role is for someone who is good at process mapping, Miro organization, workflow documentation, and turning messy planning notes into a clear visual system.



Preferred Skills:



* Strong experience with Miro

* Workflow/process mapping experience

* Ability to organize complex business processes visually

* Experience documenting automation workflows

* Familiarity with n8n, webhooks, APIs, CRM workflows, or Voice AI is helpful but not required

* Good written English

* Detail-oriented and organized

* Able to work from written notes and ask clarifying questions when needed



First Paid Test:



The first task will be a small paid test.



You will review a section of my current Miro flowchart and a short written update, then revise that section so I can confirm your style, clarity, and ability to organize the workflow.



Please include in your application:



1. Your experience with Miro.

2. Examples of workflow diagrams, process maps, or Miro boards you have created.

3. Whether you have experience documenting automation workflows.

4. Whether you are familiar with n8n, APIs, webhooks, CRM systems, or Voice AI.

5. Your hourly rate or fixed price for a small Miro cleanup/update test.

6. Your availability this week.

title: PAID MEDIA ADS MANAGER
description:
PAID MEDIA & LEAD GENERATION MANAGER



Help Build One of the UK's Most Ambitious Hospitality Brands



Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term Position



OnlineJobs.ph



---



Before You Apply



This is NOT a social media posting role.



This is NOT a Canva role.



This is NOT a
 boosting role.



This is NOT a junior marketing assistant position.



This is a growth role.



We are looking for someone who understands how to generate qualified enquiries using paid advertising and who can directly influence business growth.



We don't care how many followers you have generated.



We care how many enquiries, opportunities and customers you have helped create.



If you're looking for a role where someone tells you exactly what to do every day, this is not the role for you.



---



About Yum Street



Yum Street is a UK hospitality and events business delivering premium hospitality experiences across:



* Corporate Events

* Employee Engagement Events

* Staff Appreciation Days

* Weddings

* Sporting Venues

* Stadiums

* Festivals

* Public Events

* Private Celebrations



We believe there is no difference between our client's event and our own.



Our role is not simply to provide food.



Our role is to create memorable experiences while removing pressure from organisers and helping guests have an exceptional time.



We work with organisations, venues and event organisers who expect professionalism, reliability and outstanding delivery.



---



Why We Are Hiring



We have invested heavily in:



* Sales

* Lead Generation

* CRM Systems

* Website Development

* Content Creation

* Operational Infrastructure



Now we want to build a paid advertising engine that consistently generates qualified enquiries.



We want someone who can take ownership of our paid acquisition strategy and help drive the next phase of growth.



---



The Opportunity



You will become the owner of Yum Street's paid lead generation strategy.



Your mission is simple:



Generate qualified enquiries.



Not clicks.



Not impressions.



Not followers.



Not vanity metrics.



Qualified enquiries that convert into opportunities for our sales team.



You will work directly with the Directors and become a key member of our growth team.



---



Your Responsibilities



Google Ads



Plan, build and optimise campaigns for:



* Corporate Catering

* Corporate Events

* Employee Engagement Events

* Wedding Catering

* Wedding Food Experiences

* Food Truck Hire

* Mobile Catering

* Event Catering

* Hospitality Services



Responsibilities include:



* Keyword research

* Campaign structure

* Ad copy

* Budget management

* Conversion tracking

* Optimisation



---



Meta Advertising



 & Instagram



You will:



* Create campaigns

* Build audiences

* Develop retargeting campaigns

* Improve lead generation performance

* Test creative concepts

* Optimise conversion rates



---



TikTok Advertising



You will:



* Build awareness campaigns

* Generate enquiries

* Create audience testing frameworks

* Develop retargeting campaigns

* Identify winning content



---



Landing Page Optimisation



You will:



* Recommend landing page improvements

* Improve conversion rates

* Create testing plans

* Improve enquiry generation



We do not believe advertising success happens inside the ad platform alone.



The entire funnel matters.



---



Analytics & Reporting



You will own:



* Cost Per Lead

* Cost Per Qualified Enquiry

* Conversion Rates

* ROAS

* Lead Quality

* Campaign Performance



You will provide weekly and monthly reports focused on commercial outcomes.



---



What Success Looks Like



Success is NOT:



* More impressions

* More reach

* More clicks

* More followers



Success IS:



* More qualified enquiries

* Lower acquisition costs

* Higher conversion rates

* More opportunities for the sales team

* More revenue influenced



---



Required Experience



You MUST have:



* Minimum 4 years remote work experience

* Minimum 3 years paid advertising experience

* Proven Google Ads experience

* Proven Meta Ads experience

* Proven lead generation experience

* Experience managing advertising budgets

* Experience working directly with business owners

* Excellent written English



You must be able to demonstrate real commercial results.



---



Required Platform Knowledge



Strong experience with:



* Google Ads

* Google Analytics

* Google Tag Manager

* Meta Ads Manager

* TikTok Ads Manager

* Looker Studio

* ChatGPT

* Canva



Bonus if experienced with:



* Landing page builders

* CRM systems

* Conversion rate optimisation

* Hospitality, events or wedding marketing



---

 The Type Of Person We Want



You are:



* Commercially minded

* Highly proactive

* Data driven

* Self-managing

* Curious

* Results focused

* Comfortable challenging ideas

* Comfortable taking ownership



You don't wait for instructions.



You identify opportunities and bring solutions.



---



The Type Of Person We Do NOT Want



Please do not apply if:



* You are a beginner.

* You have limited paid advertising experience.

* You only know how to boost posts.

* You focus on vanity metrics.

* You require daily supervision.

* You cannot explain how your work generated enquiries.



---



KPIs



You will be measured on:



Primary KPIs



* Qualified Enquiries Generated

* Cost Per Qualified Enquiry

* Opportunities Created

* Revenue Influenced

* Return On Ad Spend (ROAS)



Secondary KPIs



* Landing Page Conversion Rate

* Lead Quality

* Funnel Conversion Rate



---



Working Hours



Full-Time



40 Hours Per Week



Monday to Friday



Flexible working arrangements available.



---



Reporting To



Directors



You will also work closely with:



* Lead Generation Team

* Sales Team

* CRM & Systems Team

* Marketing Team



---







Depending on experience, capability and proven results.



Exceptional candidates will be rewarded accordingly.



---



How To Apply



Please submit:



1. Your CV.

2. Your expected monthly salary.

3. Three examples of campaigns you have managed.

4. Advertising budgets managed.

5. Results achieved.

6. Cost per lead achieved.

7. Industries worked within.

8. The word AIRSTREAM at the beginning of your application so we know you have read this advert.



---



Final Message



We are not looking for an Ads Assistant.



We are not looking for someone to simply launch campaigns.



We are looking for a commercially minded Paid Media & Lead Generation Manager who wants to help build a premium hospitality brand and play a key role in its long-term growth.



If you are excited by the opportunity to directly influence enquiries, opportunities and revenue, we would love to hear from you.

title: Bilingual Project Assistant & Translator (Spanish/English)
description:
Pixel Link Networks is seeking a sharp, highly organized, and fully bilingual (Spanish/English) Project Assistant & Coordinator to support our leadership team. 



This position is for a very specific website redesign project expected to last 3 months. 



We are looking for a project assistant where you will act as the operational assistant: managing project tasks, tracking developer progress, and serving as our live translator and communicator during live Spanish-language client conference calls.



This is a remote, part-time (up to 10-15 hrs per week) position requiring overlapping hours with US Central Time (CST) for scheduled meetings and calls.



Key Responsibilities:



- Live Translation & Communication: Participate in live video/audio conference calls with our client's regional team in Mexico, translating technical discussion points between English and Spanish in real time.



- Task Management & Tracking: Maintain our project management board, ensuring tasks for our Filipino development team are clearly documented, updated, and moving forward.



- Meeting Governance: Attend project alignment meetings, take detailed notes, document action items, and follow up with tea
mbers on outstanding deliverables.



- Administrative Support: Assist the Lead Architect with project documentation, tracking data sheets, and organizing project assets.



Required Qualifications & Skills:



- Absolute Fluency in Spanish and English: You must be completely fluent in both written and spoken English and Spanish. You must feel entirely comfortable speaking, translating, and conducting business professionally on live corporate conference calls.



- Technical Literacy: Experience working with web development projects, e-commerce platforms (BigCommerce/Shopify), or content management systems is a massive plus. No coding experience needed or necessary.



- BPO/Corporate Background: Prior experience working in the Philippine BPO sector handling bilingual (Spanish/English) corporate support, tech support, or account management is highly preferred.



- Tools: Proficient with project management software ClickUp and Google Workspace (Sheets/Docs).



- Reliability: High-speed internet connection, a quiet working space for live corporate calls, and a professional headset/microphone setup.



Compensation & Schedule:

- Rate: $8.00 - $11.00 USD /hr based on experience

- Hours: Flexible task hours, but must be available during specific US Central Time (CST) business hours for live client conference calls.



How to Apply:



Please submit your background information and why you should be considered for this project. 

Also include a sharable link to a short video w/ audio introduction (1-2 minutes) using Google Drive, Dropbox, or other storage tool.



In your video recording, please spend one minute speaking in English and one minute speaking in Spanish, detailing your experience assisting with technical teams or translating on live business calls.

description:

Note: Previous experience with SMS platforms is preferred but not required. We will provide training on all campaign setup tools, platforms, and internal processes.

Campaign Management

Set up and launch SMS marketing campaigns within SMS platforms.

Schedule and manage promotional, transactional, and automated SMS campaigns.

Ensure campaigns are deployed accurately and on schedule.

Maintain campaign calendars and coordinate messaging priorities.

Copy Testing & Optimization

Create and test multiple SMS copy variations.

Conduct A/B testing on messaging, offers, CTAs, and send times.

Analyze performance metrics and implement winning variations.

Continuously improve engagement, conversion rates, and revenue.

Link & Tracking Management

Monitor automation performance and resolve issues proactively.

Produce daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports.

Revenue Optimization

Analyze campaign performance to improve profitability.

Recommend segmentation, targeting, and messaging improvements.

Optimize campaign frequency and audience selection.

Continuously test new strategies to increase customer lifetime value and revenue.

Qualifications

Strong organizational and project management skills.

Analytical mindset with attention to detail.

Ability to learn new software and marketing platforms quickly.

Experience with SMS marketing,
 marketing, digital marketing, or eCommerce is a plus.

Basic understanding of webhooks, tracking links, or marketing automations is a plus but not required.

Comfortable working with data, reports, and performance metrics.

Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.

Success Metrics

SMS revenue generated

Return on Investment (ROI)

Campaign deployment accuracy

Click-through and conversion rates

Subscriber growth

Automation performance

Testing volume and optimization improvements

Timely completion of campaigns and reporting



Training Provided



SMS platform setup and management

Campaign creation and scheduling

Link tracking and attribution

Webhook setup and troubleshooting

Reporting and ROI analysis

Internal SMS marketing strategies and best practices

title: Online Math/Science Teacher(Near-Native Accent)
description:
About Pomelo Academy

Pomelo Academy is an innovative online international school dedicated to delivering high-quality education to students worldwide. We provide a dynamic and engaging learning environment, catering to individualized instruction that transcends geographical boundaries.



Job Description

We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 Math and/or Science Teachers with verifiable teaching certifications. The ideal candidates will have strong academic backgrounds in Mathematics and/or Science, experience teaching young learners (ages 5–18), and a commitment to creating a supportive, inquiry-based, and engaging online learning environment.



Responsibilities



Deliver interactive and engaging Math and/or Science lessons to individuals and small groups of 2–6 students aged 5–18.

Teach using internationally recognized curricula such as A Closer Look, Glencoe Science, Pearson Interactive Science, NGSS-aligned resources, Singapore Math, or IB/AP/A Level Math programs.

Create age-appropriate lesson plans focused on conceptual understanding, inquiry, problem-solving, and real-world applications.

Incorporate visuals, multimedia, and hands-on virtual activities to make abstract concepts accessible and engaging.

Monitor student progress and provide timely feedback to students and parents.

Foster curiosity, discussion, and active learning in a safe and supportive space.



Qualifications



Professional teacher with at least 2 years of teaching experience (Kindergarten–Grade 12).

Must hold a valid teaching license/certification (e.g., Teaching License, State Certification). TESOL/TEFL is a plus.

Near-native English accent with excellent spoken and written communication skills.

Strong academic background in Mathematics and/or Science (Biology, Physics, Chemistry, General Science).

Experience teaching in public/international schools or reputable online platforms.

Familiarity with inquiry-based and/or interdisciplinary approaches (e.g., STEM/STEAM).

Comfortable working between 07:00–22:00 (Weekdays) and 9:00–22:00 (Weekends), GMT+8.

Proficiency with digital platforms such as ClassIn, Microsoft Office, and other educational technologies.

Must have a stable and fast internet connection and a PC/laptop with at least Windows 10 or Mac OS Catalina.



Benefits



Flexible working hours.

Opportunity to teach using globally respected Math and Science curricula.

Be part of an international, passionate team of educators.

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

title: Email Marketing Klaviyo Campaigns + Flows Manager (Growth Strategist)
description:
Role Overview

Please note that it is critical that your written and spoken English is exceptional, as you will be communicating with our clients directly. Ideally, you will have worked in an agency before or are working in an agency at present.



It is also imperative that you have a lot of Klaviyo experience. We are NOT looking for a virtual PA or generalist - we are looking for a Klaviyo expert. You should only apply for this role if you have experience in working with brands in Klaviyo, better still if you've worked in a marketing agency before. 



We are seeking an
 Marketing Strategist (Klaviyo) to join our team on a full-time basis. In this role, you will lead the strategic planning and assist with the execution of clients’
 marketing initiatives – from automation and flows to list growth strategies to advanced segmentation modelling and performance reporting. You will directly manage a small number of client accounts, serving as the growth lead who drives
 campaign planning, weekly client calls, and continual programme improvements. This is a remote/flexible position with a competitive salary.



Key Responsibilities



Strategic Planning

Develop and own comprehensive Klaviyo-led
 marketing strategies aligned to each client’s commercial goals, customer lifecycle, and retention objectives. Drive
 growth initiatives that deliver measurable improvements in engagement, conversion, and customer lifetime value, ensuring alignment with wider CRM and retention strategies.



 Automation & Execution

Lead the strategy and optimisation of automated
 programmes and customer journeys, including welcome series, abandonment flows, post-purchase, retention, and re-engagement campaigns. Ensure best practices are applied across timing, frequency, personalisation, and deliverability. While this is a strategic role, you will be comfortable supporting hands-on execution within Klaviyo where required.



List Growth & Management

Define and implement list growth strategies focused on sustainable, high-quality subscriber acquisition. Develop and optimise signup mechanisms, lead capture campaigns, incentives, and preference management approaches, while maintaining strong list health, data quality, and compliance.



Segmentation & Personalisation

Design and refine advanced segmentation models within Klaviyo to enable highly targeted and personalised campaigns. Use behavioural, transactional, and engagement data to improve relevance, drive performance, and support sophisticated lifecycle marketing.



Analytics & Reporting

Establish clear reporting frameworks and KPIs to measure
 performance, including deliverability, engagement, revenue contribution, and ROI. Analyse campaign and flow performance to surface actionable insights, and translate data into clear recommendations for continuous optimisation. Prepare and present weekly and monthly performance updates, as well as quarterly business reviews (QBRs).



Client Leadership

Act as the strategic
 lead for a handful of client accounts, building strong, trusted relationships with client stakeholders. Lead weekly client calls, guiding discussions around strategy, performance, testing opportunities, and upcoming initiatives. Serve as a Klaviyo and
 growth expert, providing confident recommendations and thought leadership.



Team Collaboration

Work closely with internal designers, copywriters, developers, and campaign managers to ensure strategies are executed accurately and efficiently. Provide clear briefs, review outputs, and ensure all
 activity aligns with strategic intent and Enchant’s quality standards.



Presentations & Documentation

Create high-quality strategy documents, campaign roadmaps, and performance presentations. Deliver clear, engaging presentations to clients that communicate strategy, results, insights, and next steps. Translate complex data and technical concepts into practical, easy-to-understand recommendations.



Compliance & Best Practices

Ensure all
 marketing activity follows industry best practices and legal requirements, including GDPR and deliverability standards. Stay up to date with Klaviyo product developments,
 trends, and regulatory changes, applying this knowledge proactively to improve client outcomes.



Skills and Experience



Experience

2+ years of demonstrable experience in
 marketing and CRM (typically a dedicated
 or lifecycle role, ideally within an agency or client-facing environment). Proven experience driving growth through strategic
 programmes.



Klaviyo &
 Expertise

Deep, hands-on expertise in Klaviyo is essential. You are confident in building and optimising campaigns, flows, segments, and reporting within Klaviyo, and you understand how to use the platform to drive retention and revenue growth. A data-driven mindset is critical.



Analytical Skills

Strong analytical ability, with confidence in interpreting
 performance data and customer behaviour. Comfortable defining KPIs, building reporting frameworks, and using tools such as Klaviyo analytics, Google Analytics, and Excel/Sheets to support insights and recommendations.



Communication & Presentation

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with fluent, professional English (British English tone preferred). Confident in leading client conversations and presenting strategy and performance to senior stakeholders. Strong presentation skills are essential.



Organisation & Autonomy

Highly organised and self-motivated, able to manage multiple client programmes simultaneously. Comfortable working independently in a remote environment, taking ownership of priorities, timelines, and outcomes.



Collaboration

A collaborative team player who works effectively with designers, copywriters, developers, and campaign teams. Open to feedback and skilled at coordinating cross-functional work to deliver high-quality results.



Industry Knowledge

Experience working with Retail, DTC, or Travel brands is advantageous, along with an understanding of customer lifecycle marketing within these sectors.



Adaptability

Comfortable adapting to new client challenges, industries, and growth objectives. Curious, proactive, and committed to continuous learning within the
 and Klaviyo ecosystem.



Education

A degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field is beneficial, but proven experience and results matter most.



Further Details

Contract Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

Salary: Competitive (negotiable based on experience and expertise)

Start Date: Immediate/ASAP (we are ready to engage the right candidate as soon as possible)





Join Enchant Agency and play a pivotal role in crafting winning
 strategies for ambitious brands. If you’re passionate about eCRM and
 marketing and have the strategic mindset and hands-on skills to drive growth for our clients, we’d love to hear from you!



About Enchant Agency

Enchant Agency is an award-winning
 marketing and eCRM agency, renowned for scaling customer retention and messaging programmes for iconic brands. We pride ourselves on innovative strategies and a collaborative, expert team that delivers exceptional results in
 marketing and CRM.

title: Head of Creator Growth & Influencer Strategy
description:
The Mission

We are looking for a high-level Growth Director to own the top-of-funnel strategy for our roster of high-performing creators. You aren't just managing social media; you are engineering the physics of the funnel. You will be the single point of responsibility for ensuring that our "Traffic" engine is always running hot, so our "Sales" engine (the Chat Team) always has a full house to convert.

Key Responsibilities

1. Ownership of the Traffic Generation Funnel

The "Fixer" Mentality: When a creator’s revenue dips, you don't wait for a prompt. You diagnose the traffic leak, audit the social media hooks, and pivot the strategy to pump fresh, high-intent leads to the subscription platforms.

Metric Stewardship: You will live in the data, tracking Revenue Velocity and SLA metrics to identify which creators need a strategic marketing push.

2. Narrative & Content Engineering

Content Pillars: You will develop and enforce personality-driven content strategies (e.g., podcast clip farming, high-conversion "Text on Screen" narratives, and "parasocial" hooks) that move beyond "pretty" content into "high-conversion" content.

Creator Consulting: You will lead the "Strategy Audits" with creators, delivering actionable tips and guides that go beyond basic posting schedules to ensure they are building a brand that converts.

3. Strategic Alignment & Collaboration

Cross-Functional Leadership: You will act as the bridge between Marketing and Community Management to ensure that the "tease" on social media perfectly aligns with the revenue goals of the community team.

Operational Accountability: You will hold creators accountable for delivering the raw materials needed for your marketing engine.

4. Agency Brand Support

Support the founders in the marketing and B2B growth of the agency itself. This includes assisting with case studies, "high-signal" proposal documents, and maintaining the agency’s reputation as a market leader.



The Profile: Who You Are

Influencer Specialist: You have 3–5+ years of experience in influencer management, talent agencies, or high-growth DTC marketing. You know how to make a personality "go viral."

Psychological Edge: You understand why people click. You treat social media like a behavioral science experiment, not an art project.

Data-Driven: You are comfortable using complex spreadsheets and automated reports to drive your decision-making. You prioritize Revenue Velocity over "likes."

Assertive Leader: You aren't afraid to get on a call with a creator and tell them their content is falling short—and then show them exactly how to fix it.

The Environment

Time Zone: We operate primarily in GMT (9 am – 9 pm).

Focus: We value high-conversion over high-fashion. We build brands that make money

opportunities and building a high-quality sales pipeline across North America, Europe, and Latin 

America.

• Talent Management Leaders

• Diversity, Equity & Inclusion Leaders 

• CEOs and Executive Leaders 



Target Organizations 

You will engage organizations that: 

• Have 500+ employees

o Leadership Development

• Uncover organizational challenges, talent gaps, and leadership development needs.

• Organizational challenge

• Executive sponsorship

• Timeline

• Decision-making process

• Ensure qualified prospects are properly prepared before handoff. 

• Support a smooth transition from qualification to consultation.

A lead will be considered qualified only when ALL of the following conditions are met: 

• The prospect is a decision-maker or strong influencer within HR, Talent Management, 

Learning & Development, Leadership Development, or Executive Management. 

• The organization has 500+ employees. 

• The prospect has articulated a specific business challenge, leadership need, or talent 

development opportunity. 

• The prospect demonstrates current or near-term interest within the next 12 months. 

• Budget exists or there is willingness to invest at a minimum level of $15,000 USD. 

• The prospect agrees to participate in a strategy discussion with Patricia Arboleda or 

another designated advisor. 



Required Qualifications

o Sales Development 

o Business Development 

o Enterprise Lead Qualification 

o Consultative Appointment Setting 

o B2B Inside Sales 

o Professional Services Sales Support 

• Excellent spoken English with a professional, neutral accent. 

• Experience conducting both outbound and inbound business conversations. 

• Experience engaging with senior-level stakeholders and decision-makers. 

• Strong CRM experience using HubSpot, Salesforce, GoHighLevel, ActiveCampaign, or 

similar platforms. 

• Excellent written communication and organizational skills. 



Required Skills 

• Consultative selling 

• Executive-level conversations 

• Discovery interviewing 

• Active listening 

• Objection handling 

• Business acumen 

• Strategic questioning 

• Relationship building 

• Ability to discuss leadership development and talent challenges with senior executives 



Preferred Experience 

Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable: 

• Leadership Development 

• Executive Coaching 

• Corporate Training 

• Talent Management 

• Human Resources Consulting 

• Organizational Development 

• Learning & Development 

• B2B Professional Services 



Experience supporting US, European, or Latin American markets is a strong advantage. 



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 

Monthly Performance Metrics 

• 100% response rate to engaged
 leads within 24 hours 

• 25–40 executive discovery conversations conducted 

• 10–15 Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) generated 

• 6–10 qualified strategy meetings booked 

• CRM completeness above 95% 

• Minimum 80% meeting attendance rate

Ideal Candidate 

You are a consultative sales professional who is comfortable engaging CHROs, Talent Directors, 

Learning & Development leaders, and CEOs in meaningful business conversations. 

You know how to ask thoughtful questions, uncover organizational challenges, evaluate strategic 

fit, and qualify opportunities based on business value rather than call volume. 

You understand that successful qualification is not measured by the number of calls made, but 

by the quality of opportunities generated and the ability to identify organizations that can 

benefit from leadership development and talent acceleration solutions. 

If you thrive in executive-level conversations and enjoy uncovering strategic opportunities that

A highly analytical mind with strong attention to detail and data tracking (Excel/Google Sheets).

A reliable, high-speed internet connection and a dependable backup power/internet solution. VPN will be provided during on-boarding.

title: LinkedIn Campaign Manager — 25+ Accounts, Agency Environment
description:
We run outbound LinkedIn campaigns across 25+ accounts and need someone to take the wheel and run them. Not a VA. Not list-building for hire. A campaign manager who owns setup, pacing, monitoring, optimisation, and account health across the whole book — and keeps it all moving without being told what to do next.



You'll get the strategy and messaging direction. What you bring is the operational command to turn that into running campaigns that perform — and the judgement to spot when something's off and fix it before it becomes a problem.

What you'll own



Set up and run outbound campaigns across 25+ LinkedIn accounts

Build targeted audiences in Sales Navigator and feed the pipeline

Manage automation (PhantomBuster / SalesRobot / Expandi / Heyreach or similar) safely at scale — every account inside safe limits, none getting flagged



Monitor the numbers — connection accept rates, reply rates, conversation flow — and adjust pacing and targeting to keep them healthy



Diagnose underperforming campaigns and actually fix them

Manage account health across the book — warming, limits, restrictions, recovery

Report on what's working and what isn't, clearly and on time

Proven experience running LinkedIn outreach campaigns — not just executing tasks inside someone else's

Multi-account / agency experience — you've managed many profiles at once, not one

Fluent with Sales Navigator and at least one automation platform (PhantomBuster, SalesRobot, Expandi, Heyreach, Dripify, etc.)



Deep working knowledge of LinkedIn limits, what triggers restrictions, and how to recover an account

You read metrics and act on them — you know what a bad accept rate is telling you

Sharp, organised, responsive — across 25 accounts, small misses scale fast



This isn't for you if



You're a VA looking for task work — this is ownership

Your experience is one company page, or "social media management"

You've never run automation across multiple accounts at once

You need to be told every step



Nice to have



Experience inside an agency or supporting founders / B2B service businesses

CRM familiarity

A point of view on outreach strategy, not just execution



The work



Ongoing. Consistent weekly campaign management with the autonomy to run things. Some availability needed during UK hours, 7am–3pm. Long-term for the right person — this is a seat, not a one-off.

The most LinkedIn accounts you've run outbound campaigns across at one time — 

what platform, and how you kept them safe at that scale

your familiarity with tools such as Phantombuster



A campaign you turned around — what the numbers were doing, what you changed, what happened

How you handle an account that gets restricted mid-campaign

title: Tik Tok Shop Video editor/VA
description:
Job Title: Virtual Assistant / Video Editor for TikTok Shop (Beginner Friendly)



About the Role



I am looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to help me with basic video editing for my TikTok Shop account. The tasks are super simple, and beginners are more than welcome to apply! I will provide the raw clips, and your job will be to make quick, basic edits to get them ready for posting.



Responsibilities



The two most important parts of this job are the following, and they should be your main focus with every video:



1. Cut out all dead space between clips. The videos need to be fast-paced and tight. Any pauses, gaps, or slow 
nts between clips must be removed so the viewer stays engaged from start to finish. Retention is everything on TikTok, and a well-paced edit is the number one priority.



2. Add plenty of overlays and photos throughout the video. You will be finding and inserting relevant images and overlays consistently throughout each video to keep the viewer visually stimulated and watching. The more engaging the visuals, the better.



In addition to the above, you will also add a few brief onscreen text captions throughout the video to summarize key points. These do not need to be excessive — just enough to reinforce what is being said and help viewers who are watching without sound.



Requirements



The main technical requirement for this job is that you must have a smartphone capable of downloading and running TikTok Studio. All editing will be done using this specific app, which is completely free and very easy to use.



No advanced editing experience is required, and beginners are absolutely fine! You just need to be willing to learn, follow simple instructions, and have a reliable internet connection to receive raw clips and upload the finished videos.



Attention to detail is a must. To ensure you are reading this entire job post, at the subject of your application, put your favorite season of the year. If you do not have this, we will not consider you for this job.



Pay & Schedule



The pay rate for this position is $4.00 USD per hour, paid weekly. You will be required to keep a timesheet logging your hours worked each day, which will be used to calculate your weekly payment.



In terms of workload, I typically produce between 4 and 9 videos per day. The editing tasks are intentionally simple, so you should be able to comfortably complete around 4 videos per hour. On a typical day, this means the work will take you roughly 1 to 2.5 hours to complete.



Workflow



Raw video clips will be shared with you through a shared Google Drive folder. You will download the clips, edit them using TikTok Studio on your phone, and then re-upload the finished videos back to the same Google Drive folder. No complicated file-sharing tools — just a simple, straightforward process.



All edited videos must be returned within 24 hours of receiving the raw clips. For example, if I send you the clips on Monday, I need them back by Tuesday. This turnaround time is essential so I can maintain a consistent daily posting schedule.



Growth Opportunity



This is not just a one-off project — I am looking for someone to grow with long-term. As my TikTok Shop continues to scale, there will be opportunities for increased hours, additional responsibilities, and higher pay for the right person. If you are reliable, consistent, and take pride in your work, there is a real future here.

title: TCG Purchasing & Sourcing Manager (Remote)
description:
### TCG Purchasing & Sourcing Manager (Remote)



We're looking for someone who can consistently source Pokémon and One Piece trading cards below market value, both raw and graded. The role will primarily involve monitoring eBay,
 groups,
 Marketplace, and other trading card platforms to identify profitable opportunities, negotiate purchases, and identify cards with strong grading potential.



### Responsibilities



* Monitor eBay,
 groups, Marketplace, 
 communities, and other trading card platforms daily.

* Identify raw and graded cards listed below current market value.

* Research recent sales data and market trends to determine fair market value.

* Negotiate with sellers to secure the best possible prices.

* Present buying opportunities along with expected profit margins.

* Source collections, singles, sealed products, and other inventory opportunities.

* Assess raw cards for grading potential before purchase.

* Review photos and scans to evaluate centering, corners, edges, and surface condition.

* Estimate likely grades for PSA, CGC, and BGS submissions.

* Identify cards with strong grading upside and profit potential.

* Calculate expected returns after grading fees, shipping costs, and selling fees.

* Flag potential authenticity concerns, alterations, trimming, cleaning, or other issues that may impact grading outcomes.

* Track purchases and maintain sourcing records.

* Build relationships with collectors, dealers, and community members.

* Assist in expanding sourcing efforts into additional TCGs and sports cards as the business grows.



### Requirements



* Strong knowledge of Pokémon and One Piece TCG.

* Ability to accurately assess card values and market trends.

* Experience using eBay,
 Marketplace,
 Groups, and other card-selling platforms.

* Strong negotiation and communication skills.

* Experience evaluating cards for grading submissions.

* Understanding of PSA, CGC, and BGS grading standards.

* Ability to estimate likely grades from photos and scans.

* Understanding of factors affecting grades, including centering, corners, edges, surface quality, print defects, and factory damage.

* Comfortable working independently and managing daily sourcing targets.

* Reliable internet connection and willingness to use a VPN when required.



### Expected Reporting Format



When presenting opportunities, you should provide:



* Card name

* Platform/source

* Purchase price

* Current market value

* Expected resale value

* Estimated grading outcome (if applicable)

* Estimated profit after all fees and costs

* Reasoning behind the recommendation



Example:



Card: Japanese Promo Pikachu

Purchase Price: $250 AUD

Estimated Grade: PSA 9 (70%) / PSA 10 (20%)

PSA 9 Market Value: $600 AUD

PSA 10 Market Value: $1,500 AUD

Estimated Costs: $50 AUD

Expected Profit: $250–$1,200 AUD

Recommendation: Buy



### Success in This Role Will Be Measured By



* Number of profitable purchases secured.

* Average discount from market value.

* Total profit generated from sourced inventory.

* Accuracy of pre-grade assessments.

* Percentage of purchased raw cards that achieve expected grades.

* ROI generated from grading submissions.

* Consistency and quality of sourcing opportunities.



### Compensation



Base salary plus performance incentives based on the profitability of sourced inventory.



This is a full-time role. We are looking for someone who can consistently find high-quality buying opportunities every day and become a key part of our long-term growth strategy.

mbers flagged as critically over- or under-allocated.

mber is critically over- or under-allocated; proactively rebalance workload across the team.

mbers can execute without ambiguity.

/Klaviyo.

mbers are flagged as critically over- or under-allocated.
