title: *Web Designer (UX/UI) — Gig*
description:
*Web Designer (UX/UI) — Gig*

Boutique Video Production Studio — New York



*About the Role*

We're a boutique video production studio based in New York City, specializing in corporate image films, brand documentaries, and event films — primarily for European companies operating in the US market.

We're rebuilding our website, and we need someone who understands that a studio site isn't just a portfolio — it's a sales tool. Every page has a job to do: communicate who we are, build trust with a specific type of client, and move them toward picking up the phone.

We're looking for a Web Designer who leads with structure and ends with craft. Someone who opens a new project by thinking about pages, user flow, and hierarchy — not colors and typefaces. The visual execution matters enormously, but it comes last.

You'll work directly with the founder on a project basis, with potential for ongoing work as we grow. You'll own the design process from sitemap to handoff, working within Wix (or Webflow if you can make a case for it). Copy and video assets will be provided — your job is to make them land.



*Who You Are*

You understand the web as a medium, not a canvas. You think about scroll behaviour, states, responsiveness, and hierarchy the way a developer thinks about logic: it either works or it doesn't.



You're not a graphic designer who builds websites on the side. Web design is your specialism. It's where your thinking lives.



*What You'll Do*

You'll take ownership of the full website project from concept to launch — starting with strategy, not aesthetics. Before a single frame gets designed, you'll need to understand our brand, our clients, and our business goals.

1. Strategy & Concept

• Develop the sitemap, define page hierarchy, and map out the user flow

• Make deliberate structural decisions before moving into design

• Understand what a service-based studio site needs to do commercially, not just visually

2. Design & Build

• Design and build a 5–7 page website in Wix (including Wix Developer tools) or Webflow

• Deliver fully responsive designs for both desktop and mobile — not just scaled-down versions of each other

• Understand scroll behavior, interactive states, and responsiveness as logic problems, not just visual ones

• Apply hierarchy the way a developer thinks: what loads first, what earns attention, what drives action

3. Conversion & SEO

• Build a conversion-focused site that actively moves a visitor toward becoming a client

• Implement proper SEO foundations from day one: meta titles, header structures, and technical configurations

• Structure content and copy placement for both readability and search performance

4. Technical Setup

• Handle hosting setup, domain transfer, and any migrations required

• Deliver a clean handoff so the site is fully live and running from day one

• Manage any technical configurations independently — no handholding needed



*What We're Looking For*

Required:

• 3+ years specializing in web design — not general graphic, brand, or print design

• A genuine process: sitemap ? wireframe ? visual design, every time

• Strong information architecture skills — you can define page structure, navigation logic, and content hierarchy from a brief

• Deep understanding of web UX: conversion logic, scroll behavior, mobile-first thinking, and interactive states

• Expert-level skills in either Wix (including Wix Developer / Velo) or Webflow — tell us which one and show us what you've built with it

• A portfolio of live websites for service-based businesses or creative studios that shows process, not just final output

• Clear, proactive communicator in English — you flag problems early and ask the right questions



*How to Apply*

Send us the following:

• Your portfolio — live websites only. We're not interested in Dribbble shots, unsolicited redesigns, or graphic design work. Show us websites you actually shipped.

• 1–2 case studies that walk us through your process: how you structured the site, the thinking behind the page hierarchy, and how the final design connects back to the brief. The thinking matters as much as the output. Bonus points if any of them are for a creative studio, production company, or service-based business.

• A short introduction: who you are, what kinds of projects you've worked on, your platform of choice (Wix or Webflow), and your rate for a project like this.



Compensation

• $400–600 flat project fee for the full website (5–7 pages), depending on complexity and experience

• Ongoing retainer available for post-launch support, updates, and maintenance — billed hourly at a rate we agree on upfront

We're looking for the best fit, not the cheapest option. If your work is strong and your process is solid, we're open to discussing rate.

About This Role

I run a busy real estate brokerage in Toronto, Canada. I'm looking for ONE exceptional, long-term virtual assistant to become my right hand on real estate transactions — from listing launch to closing day — plus general executive assistant support.



This is NOT a data-entry job. You will be in direct group chats with my clients, and I expect you to be proactive — handling things in those chats before I even have to respond. You'll be drafting real documents and managing real deadlines where mistakes cost real money. If you are detail-obsessed, proactive, and reliable, you will love this role and I will invest in you long-term.





What You'll Do

Listing side (selling a home):



Draft listing agreements (Ontario OREA forms), MLS data forms, seller intake forms, and pre-list
s

Book and follow up with photographers, stagers, and cleaners; book condo elevators

Use AI tools (Gemini, Claude, or similar) to touch up and edit listing photos before MLS upload

Source floor plans; upload MLS listings from draft and update them (price changes, sold/firm status)

Manage conditional dates in Google Calendar; call buyer agents for showing feedback

Coordinate lawyers, FINTRAC ID records, and complete document packages for closing



Buyer side:



Update Follow Up Boss CRM after consults; maintain buyer tracking sheets

Book showings; prepare a monthly carry cost calculator (templated Google Sheet) per property — mortgage payment, property tax, condo fees, insurance

Research schools and catchments

After a firm deal: coordinate lawyers, document packages, utility hookups, condo move-in/elevator bookings



General EA work:



Calendar management, file organization in Google Drive (DocuSign filing), CMA updates in Google Sheets using GeoWarehouse data

Lockbox management — assignments, codes, locations, and retrieval across all active listings



Client communication:



Stay active and responsive in WhatsApp group chats with clients during Toronto business hours





You're a Great Fit If You:

Have experience with Canadian real estate transactions — Ontario/Toronto experience is strongly preferred

Are genuinely detail-oriented — you catch errors others miss

Are proactive — you see what's coming next and handle it BEFORE being asked. My last assistant needed constant reminders. If that sounds like you, please don't apply.

Have excellent written English

Can follow a specific, documented workflow exactly — and suggest improvements to it

Use AI tools in your actual daily work — not as a novelty, but to draft faster, catch errors, and build things more efficiently. Tell me which tools you use and how.



Software we use (experience with any is a plus; we'll train the rest): Gmail, Google Drive, Google Sheets, BrokerBay, MLS (TRREB Matrix), REALM, DocuSign, Follow Up Boss, Adobe Acrobat, Trello, Loom, Bitly, ShareX, Gemini/AI tools, WhatsApp





How to Apply (READ CAREFULLY — this is the first test)

Detail orientation matters in this job, so your application IS the first screening step. Applications that miss any step below will not be read.



Start your application with the word "LOCKBOX" in the first line.

Tell me about ONE real estate transaction you supported from start to finish — what you personally handled and one mistake you caught or prevented.

Answer this scenario in 3–5 sentences: "A deal's financing condition expires tomorrow at 5 PM. You haven't heard from the buyer's agent and I'm in meetings all day. What do you do, step by step?"

Include a Loom or video link (2–3 minutes) introducing yourself and walking me through your experience. Speaking English on camera is required.

List your available working hours in Toronto time (EST) and your expected monthly salary. Please note that payment is made in CAD.



I respond to every complete application. Incomplete applications are deleted unread — that's the job in a nutshell.



Looking forward to meeting you.

title: Accountant
description:
US Accountant

Aoede LLC | 100% Remote | Full-Time



About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized US Accountant to manage day-to-day accounting operations, financial recordkeeping, reconciliations, payroll support, compliance filings, and reporting activities. The ideal candidate has experience with US accounting processes, property-related accounting, and accounting software such as QuickBooks and AppFolio.





What You'll Do



Accounts Receivable (AR)

• Monitor incoming payments related to rent payments

• Verify outstanding rent balances from Assistant Property Manager

• Verify payment postings and resolve discrepancies



Accounts Payable (AP)

• Verify vendor invoices, bills, and supporting documentation 

• Organize and maintain AP invoices and receipts

• Record bills and expenses accurately in the accounting system

• Prepare and process vendor payments



Payroll Administration

• Maintain employee timesheets with accuracy and completeness

• Process payroll through Gusto

• Record payroll journal entries and payroll-related liabilities

• Maintain payroll records

• Assist with payroll tax compliance and reporting

 

Bank & Credit Card Management

• Record bank statement transactions accurately

• Record and categorize credit card transactions and expenses

• Perform monthly bank reconciliations

• Perform monthly credit card reconciliations

• Investigate and resolve reconciliation discrepancies



Accounting & Financial Reporting

• Prepare necessary adjusting journal entries

• Maintain accurate general ledger records

• Ensure all accounts are reconciled



Tax & Compliance Support

• Prepare and maintain 1099 forms for vendors

• Assist with W-2 preparation and payroll documentation

• Monitor and maintain records for property tax and MUD tax balances and due dates

• Track annual filing deadlines and compliance requirements

• Assist with state and local filings as needed



Audit & Documentation

• Prepare audit support documents and schedules

• Organize financial records for audits and compliance reviews

• Maintain accurate and accessible digital filing systems



Task & Team Coordination

• Manage accounting-related tasks

• Provide weekly presentations to the team

• Coordinate with property managers, vendors, and internal staff regarding accounting matters

• Assist management with special projects and financial analysis



Additional Responsibilities

• Maintain organized accounting files and documentation

• Monitor recurring expenses and subscriptions

• Ensure compliance with company accounting policies and procedures

• Perform other accounting and administrative duties as assigned





What We're Looking For



• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field preferred

• Experience with US accounting and bookkeeping practices

• Familiarity with property management accounting is a plus

• Experience using accounting and payroll software

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets

• Strong organizational and analytical skills

• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy

• Ability to manage multiple deadlines and priorities

• Strong communication and reporting skills





What We Offer



• 100% remote position — work from home

• Long-term role with real growth potential

• Raises considered at performance evaluations for those who master the training material and execute at a high level

• Extensive runbooks and tutorials to support your development

• Annual team bonding trips in the Philippines

• A team culture that values hard work, initiative, and continuous learning





Our Hiring Process



1. Apply — Submit your application with the details listed below

2. Initial Review — We review your experience and qualifications

3. Assessment — Qualified candidates receive a TestGorilla skills assessment (~1 hour, webcam required)

4. Interview — Candidates who score at or above the 50th percentile are invited to a Zoom interview

5. Offer & Onboarding — Successful candidates begin with a 3-month probation period with full training and support





Frequently Asked Questions



What types of properties will I manage?

You'll support a diversified portfolio that includes a 70-unit commercial building in Houston, single-family rental homes in California, and short-term rental (Airbnb) properties in Austin. This role gives you broad exposure across multiple property types.



What are the working hours?

You will be expected to work US Central Time business hours. This is a full-time position (40 hours/week).



How and when do I get paid?

Pay is on the 1st and 15th of each month via Wise (
).



Is this freelance or full-time?

This is a full-time, dedicated position. Freelancing or side work is not allowed. We need your full commitment.



Do you provide equipment?

You must have your own laptop, headset, and reliable high-speed internet connection.



Is there a probation period?

Yes, there is a 3-month probation period. After that, performance evaluations are conducted every 6 months.



How do raises and bonuses work?

We offer on-the-spot bonuses for exceptional work. Raises are considered at your 6-month performance evaluations based on how well you learn the training material and execute your responsibilities.



What training and support do you provide?

We have extensive runbooks, tutorials, and experienced tea
mbers to help you get up to speed. We invest in people who are willing to learn.



What software will I need to learn?

AppFolio (property management), QuickBooks (accounting), Asana (task management), Slack (communication), and Zoom (meetings). If you don't know all of these yet, that's okay — what matters is your willingness to learn quickly.



---



To Apply



Please include:

1. A brief summary of your accounting experience

2. Which Western countries you've supported (if any)

3. What types of properties you've managed (commercial, residential, short-term rental)

4. What  accounting software you've used

5. Your availability to start





About Aoede LLC



Aoede LLC is a Texas-based property management company overseeing a growing, diversified portfolio of commercial, single-family, and short-term rental properties across Texas and California. Founded with the mindset of a startup but built on enterprise-level professional experience, we move fast, build smart, and hold ourselves to a high standard.



Our team of 10+ professionals spans multiple countries and operates fully remote, managing everything from a 70-unit commercial building in Houston to Airbnb properties in Austin and single-family rentals in California. We hire talent from around the world — including the Philippines, Vietnam, India, Sri Lanka, Pakistan, Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana, South Africa, Venezuela, and beyond. We don't care where you sit. We care how you perform.



What makes us different: we combine the speed and scrappiness of a startup with the processes, structure, and professionalism you'd expect from a much larger organization. We invest heavily in documentation — our runbooks and tutorials are built so that the right person can get up to speed quickly and operate independently. We reward performance, not tenure. If you learn the material, execute at a high level, and take ownership of your work, you'll grow here.



Our culture is built on communication, collaboration, and humility. We operate as a team — not in silos. Everyone, from leadership down, is open to feedback and willing to hear what they need to do to improve. We're not perfect and we don't pretend to be. What we do is strive for continuous improvement and learning every single day. Leadership is genuinely invested in finding better ways to do things, and we expect the same mindset from everyone on the team.





A Note on Honesty



We value honesty over impressive claims. Please don't tell us you're an expert in something you've only read about or briefly touched. It's okay to say "I've used AppFolio a few times but I'm not an expert" or "I haven't handled evictions before but I'm willing to learn." We will find out the truth — whether it's during the assessment, the interview, or the first week on the job. And when we do, it damages trust that's very hard to rebuild.



We would much rather hire someone who says "I don't know that yet, but I'll learn it" than someone who claims to know everything and can't deliver. Being humble, honest about where you are, and willing to put in the work to grow — that's what gets you far here. We have the training, the runbooks, and the team support to get the right person up to speed. What we can't teach is integrity.



We're actively expanding our portfolio and our team. We do annual team bonding trips because we believe the people behind the work matter just as much as the work itself.



This is a company where your work matters, your voice is heard, and your growth is directly tied to what you put in.

About Shades of Elegance



Shades of Elegance is a B2B window furnishings manufacturer supplying trade partners across Australia. We work with retailers, designers, builders, installers and other businesses, providing custom blinds, curtains, shutters, outdoor blinds and related window furnishing products.



We are looking for a detail-focused Admin, Order Processing & Systems Support Officer to support our curtain admin workflow, order accuracy, basic accounts tasks, and system improvement projects.

The Admin, Order Processing & Systems Support Officer will support the daily processing of curtain orders, order audits, fabric planning, track scheduling, customer payment checks, basic accounts updates, and admin system maintenance.



The role requires strong attention to detail, confidence working with order information, and the ability to identify errors before they affect production. This role suits someone who can work independently, ask the right questions, and make sure nothing is missed before an order moves into production.

Your resume.

)

• Reply rate

 A reply only counts if it shows real interest in collaboration

 Only ONE follow-up

 Applications will be rejected if:

title: YouTube Thumbnail Designer & Creative Strategist
description:
The Pickleball Lab (
 & 
) is looking for an elite YouTube Thumbnail Designer who understands that a great thumbnail is 50% strategy and 50% design. You won’t just be "making graphics"—you will be responsible for the first step in our packaging chain: CTR.



We average 1%–4% CTR (not great) and are looking for someone who can help us push a lot higher. Our Suggested Videos CTR is 1% and Browse is around 10%. Help us get higher.



What You’ll Be Doing:



- Thumbnail Strategy: You will take our video title we created for youtube and help us d
 on the thumbnail strategy. You can request specific facial expressions or poses from the owners to match your vision.

- Design & Execution: Create high-quality, custom thumbnails for the following categories of our videos:

1) Podcasts (60%)

2) Film Study (30%)

3) Coaching videos (10%).



- Occasional Flat Assets: Design static graphics (charts, overlays, diagrams) that our editor will turn into motion graphics for our videos.



Requirements (Must-Have):



- Advanced Photoshop Skills: You must be a true designer. No Canva. No templates. We require the final .PSD files for every project. If you design 100% in AI instead of using it to generate assets which you use in Photoshop, DO NOT APPLY. It is a waste of our time and yours.

- CTR Strategy Mindset: You understand "Curiosity Gaps," visual storytelling, and how to stop the scroll on Suggested Videos and the YouTube Homepage.

- Communication: Excellent English is a must. You will be expected to collaborate on and explain your design choices and suggest strategy during U.S. work hours.

- Turnaround: Consistent 24-hour turnaround for thumbnails.

- Follows Instructions: You are detail-oriented and don't miss the small stuff.



Details:



- Platform: Long-form YouTube.

- Volume: Average of 7 thumbnails per month (Part
).

- Collaboration: We use Slack and Trello. You are expected to do the same.

- Assets: We provide high-quality studio-lit footage/photos. You perform the cutouts and compositing.

- Design Rules: One to two words of text (typically, open to your suggestions). Clean, standing out from the "crowded/noisy" pickleball niche.



Trial/Selection Process:

If your portfolio stands out, we will invite you to a Two-Part Test:

- Skill Test: We provide exact thumbnail instructions to see how well you follow a brief.

- Strategy Test: We provide a video topic and raw assets, and you create a thumbnail based purely on your own strategic vision.



Bonus & Compensation:

- Starting as a part-time contractor with the potential to move into a full-time role if our needs require it down the line (not a given)

- We are open to performance bonuses for significant jumps in Click-Through Rate. This would have to be negotiated down the line.



When you apply send me:



1. Cost per thumbnail



2. Any bulk discounts you give



3. How many revisions?



4. Are you open to doing the 2 part test project so we can see your skills? You may watermark the thumbnail. If we like it, we may purchase it from you.



5. Link your portfolio of youtube thumbnails



6. Link your portfolio of other graphic design assets



7. Do you have experience in Photoshop or similar software? If so, detail your experience here. If not, please do not apply (we mean this. We know you want to apply anyway and ignore this but if you can't use photoshop or similar software to edit and only use AI, you won't be able to generate the thumbnails we need. You will waste your time on the test and our time as well.)



8. Do you use AI at all? If so, which ones? And what do you use it for?



9. Talk about your experience designing youtube thumbnails



10. Talk about your experience with youtube thumbnail strategy (if you have any)



11. Have you ever worked on a YouTube strategy team where they had strategy calls, etc. and if so, what was that experience like?



12. Have you ever adjusted your strategy based on YouTube's analytics like CTR, etc.? If so, explain more.



13. Why do you think you'd be a good fit for this project?



14. Any other information you think would be helpful



15. What are your work hours? Do you work on PH time or US time?



Looking forward to speaking with you!

title: Spanish speaking sales reps
description:
Job Description: Client Concierge Representative (CCR) | Home Services Concierge, Spanish sales rep.



Intro

This will be our first time exploring a VA (Virtual Assistant) sales representative role. We are still determining the exact start date, but we are actively looking to begin conversations and find the right fit for our team.



About Utility Helpers

Utility Helpers is a concierge service that helps homebuyers set up utilities and home services when they move into a new home.



We partner with real estate agents and lenders who refer their clients to us. We coordinate services like:



Electricity

Water

Trash

Internet / TV / Phone

Home security

Moving services

Home warranty options



Our goal is simple: make moving easier by handling everything in one streamlined conversation.



The Role

You will be the main point of contact for new homeowners referred to us by real estate professionals.



These are high-intent conversations — customers already need these services. Your role is to guide them, simplify their decisions, and help complete their setup in one call whenever possible.



This role combines:



Customer experience

Consultative sales

Service coordination



Strong CCRs confidently lead conversations, make recommendations, and help customers finalize decisions without unnecessary delays.



What You’ll Do



Speak with homebuyers referred by partners

Guide customers through utility and home service setup

Coordinate service activations based on move-in timelines

Educate and recommend service options

Help customers complete selections during the call

Present optional services in a consultative way

Document details in the CRM

Provide a professional and friendly experience



Most interactions are handled by phone, with some
 follow-up as needed.



What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)



Confidently guiding customers through the full process

Leading conversations that result in clear decisions

Converting calls into completed service setups

Minimizing follow-ups by completing during the first call

Demonstrating strong product knowledge

Maintaining high customer satisfaction

Keeping CRM records accurate



Who Thrives in This Role

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys leading conversations and helping customers move forward with confidence.



Top performers:



Build rapport quickly

Make clear recommendations

Guide customers to decisions

Stay organized and detail-oriented

Take ownership of the conversation



This Role May Not Be a Fit If



You prefer only providing information without guiding decisions

You rely heavily on follow-ups instead of closing on the call

You are uncomfortable with sales conversations



Our goal is to solve the customer’s needs in one interaction whenever possible.



Application Questions



What type of sales or customer service role have you worked in most recently?

Approximately how many customer conversations did you handle per day?

How were you measured for success (KPIs, conversions, etc.)?

Describe a time you helped a customer make a decision on the spot

How do you guide unsure customers toward a decision?
